integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof, complete source citations and a standalone finite verifier; no assertion that finite tests establish infinite results.
scientific_limitations: Exact for binary Dyck words only, not arbitrary context-free languages; shortest-border distribution only, not full border spectrum. Equivalence elsewhere remains possible. Independent review not performed.
title: Abelian-unbordered Dyck words: a Catalan-squared renewal law and limiting density
